staticWpmReplayPoints.assertion: Each 4x4 footprint is ground-unblocked in games/chicken-farm/assets/data/wpm_pathing_grid.json. Runtime input/pathing remains SP-06-02 and later.

currentStaticPath: Use I009 once to create a complete, skip-cost campfire/basic feeding well.
Use I00F once to create a complete, skip-cost market.
Use I003 up to five times to create owner-3 basic chickens.
A basic chicken lays one I006 every 30 seconds while alive; the basic well feeds but does not accelerate egg laying.
Collect an I006 stack, then sell it at the completed market for 12 gold per egg.
normalBootstrap.blocker: coop_basic costs 120 gold and 52 lumber, while normal starts at 0 lumber. exchangeEnabled is false and no runtime lumber-mill income write exists.

sp06_04_decision.minimumPath: At a completed owner market, add the original first exchange tier: spend 100 gold and receive 70 lumber. This funds one coop_basic without raising starting resources or debug grants.
sourceEvidence: item_catalog_reference.tsv I000 describes the same conversion
sp06_04_decision.outOfScope: Lumber-mill periodic income, exchange tiers above 100 -> 70, and runtime building requires stay with SP-09 unless SP-06-04 reveals they are necessary for this first loop.

ownershipAndInventory.owner: Field pickup, coop deposit/hatch, and market sale require the same owner for actor, item/inventory, and completed target building. Market-owner validation is missing in the current runtime and belongs to SP-06-10.
ownershipAndInventory.slots: Farmer and coop inventories each have six slots. A matching rawcode merges into one stack with no per-stack cap; a different rawcode needs an empty slot.

atomicity.pickup: Move the complete field stack or leave field and inventory unchanged.
atomicity.deposit: Move the complete selected I006 stack or restore the exact source stack and leave coop unchanged.
atomicity.sale: Remove and pay for the complete selected I006 stack exactly once, or preserve both stack and wallet.
atomicity.hatchStart: Consume exactly one I006 and create one job, or preserve egg and job count.

ownershipAndInventory.storedEggs: Derived from the coop I006 inventory total after every supported mutation; it is never an independent wallet or balance source.

hatchAndSupply.supply: Current economy chickens neither reserve nor consume supply. SP-06 preserves this until SP-09 defines production/supply integration; hatch must not fail solely from supply in SP-06.

removalAndExitPolicy.coop: Completed-coop removal has no refund. Discard its stored I006 inventory, cancel its hatch jobs, and create no completion chicken. Record both quantities in SP-06-12's ledger.
removalAndExitPolicy.well: Completed-well removal discards no eggs and removes feeding/egg effects immediately.
removalAndExitPolicy.market: Completed-market removal discards no carried eggs; it cancels pending sales and prevents future sales until another completed same-owner market exists.
removalAndExitPolicy.farmer: Farmer death/removal cancels economy tasks and discards that farmer's inventory once. This is not yet implemented or verified and belongs to SP-06-11/12.
removalAndExitPolicy.hatchExit: A completed hatch with no valid, unblocked production exit stays pending and retains its job. It must never use the current missing-coop (0,0) fallback or create a chicken inside a blocker.

knownCurrentGaps: I003 is consumed before its spawn point is checked for WPM/building collision; SP-06-03 makes this atomic.
basic campfire/well feeds chickens but only windmill accelerates eggs; SP-06-05 fixes or explicitly preserves the gameplay mapping.
completeHatches can create a chicken from a missing coop at (0,0); SP-06-09 replaces it with pending/retry behavior.
removeEconomyBuilding silently removes coop inventory and hatch jobs; SP-06-12 adds quantity accounting and task cleanup.
market sale validates completion/type but not market owner; SP-06-10 adds same-owner validation.

performed: 4x4 WPM ground-block checks at the three replay points
notPerformed: Actual input, movement, economy, or wallet assertions
